line.name: Henry Clay Rustic Cheroot
line.description: A cheroot format (closed footer with a pigtail cap, unlike traditional open-ended cheroots). Blend name 'Capa Dura,' described by Altadis as producing 'a rich, stronger blend.' Includes 'reborn' (recycled/repurposed) leaf in the filler. Announced March 1, 2018; national rollout April 2018. At launch: 20-count boxes, $4.25/cigar.
line.factory: Not stated in sources found - unverified

vitolas.notes: Single size only - no other vitolas in this line.
